Docs.summary: The resource ID of the Azure Container Apps environment to link to the sandbox group. A sandbox group can be linked after creation, but the link cannot then be changed or removed. For subsequent create-or-update (PUT) requests, specify the same environment ID; omitting or changing it returns 409 Conflict. Omitting it from an update (PATCH) request leaves the existing link unchanged.
